audit_status.source_base: Greek 2 Corinthians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for third heaven, thorn, grace sufficient, power perfected in weakness, apostolic signs, parental refusal to burden, fears over community disorder.

verses.restored: It is necessary to boast; not beneficial indeed, but I will come to visions and unveilings of the Lord.

familiar.text: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

verses.restored: I know a human in Messiah, fourteen years ago, whether in body I do not know, or outside the body I do not know, the Divine knows, such a one was snatched up to the third heaven.

familiar.text: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.

verses.restored: And I know such a human, whether in body or apart from the body I do not know, the Divine knows,

familiar.text: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)

verses.restored: that this one was snatched into paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not permitted for a human to speak.

familiar.text: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

verses.restored: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on behalf of myself I will not boast except in weaknesses.

familiar.text: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.

verses.restored: For if I should want to boast, I will not be foolish, for I will speak truth; but I refrain, lest anyone account to me beyond what one sees in me or hears from me.

familiar.text: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.

verses.restored: And because of the surpassing greatness of the unveilings, so that I might not be lifted up, a thorn in the flesh was given to me, a messenger of the adversarial one, so that it might strike me, so that I might not be lifted up.

familiar.text: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.

verses.restored: Concerning this I appealed to the Lord three times, that it might withdraw from me.

familiar.text: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.

verses.restored: And he has said to me: My grace is sufficient for you, for power is completed in weakness. Therefore most gladly I will rather boast in my weaknesses, so that the power of Messiah may dwell upon me.

familiar.text: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

verses.restored: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in insults, in necessities, in pursuits/persecutions and constraints, because of Messiah; for whenever I am weak, then I am powerful.

familiar.text: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ’s sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.

verses.restored: I have become foolish; you compelled me. For I ought to have been recommended by you, for I lacked nothing of the super-apostles, even if I am nothing.

familiar.text: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.

verses.restored: Indeed the signs of the apostle were worked out among you in all endurance, in signs and wonders and powers.

familiar.text: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.

verses.restored: For in what were you made less than the rest of the assemblies, except that I myself did not burden you? Forgive me this injustice.

familiar.text: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.

verses.restored: Look, this third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not burden you; for I do not seek your things but you. For the children are not obligated to store up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

familiar.text: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

verses.restored: And I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls/lives. If loving you more abundantly, am I loved less?

familiar.text: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.

verses.restored: But be that as it may, I did not burden you; yet, being crafty, I took you by deceit?

familiar.text: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.

verses.restored: Did I take advantage of you through any of those whom I sent to you?

familiar.text: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?

verses.restored: I appealed to Titus and sent the sibling with him. Did Titus take advantage of you? Did we not walk in the same Spirit? Not in the same footsteps?

familiar.text: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?

verses.restored: Have you been thinking all along that we are defending ourselves to you? Before the Divine, in Messiah, we speak; and all things, beloved, are for your building up.

familiar.text: Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.

verses.restored: For I fear lest somehow, coming, I may find you not such as I wish, and I may be found by you such as you do not wish; lest somehow there be strife, jealousy, angers, selfish ambitions, slanders, whisperings, puffings up, disorders;

familiar.text: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:

verses.restored: lest when I come again, my Divine may humble me before you, and I may mourn many of those who sinned/misaligned before and did not turn/realign from the uncleanness and sexual immorality/misuse and shameless excess that they practiced.

familiar.text: And lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.

translation_notes: The thorn is not identified; restored layer preserves ambiguity and avoids medical/spiritual overclaiming.
Power perfected in weakness is central to the letter and must not be twisted into glorifying abuse or refusing help.
